mapper.select: SELECT '온라인헌금' AS title, '헌금 종류에 맞는 계좌와 송금자명을 확인해 주세요.' AS subtitle, '이름 + 생년월일(6자리) + 헌금 약자를 입력해 주세요.' AS namingGuide, '홍길동991212주' AS namingExample

SELECT 'general' AS accountType, '일반헌금계좌' AS accountLabel, '신한은행' AS bankName, '123-456-789012' AS accountNumber, '다사랑교회' AS accountHolder UNION ALL SELECT 'mission' AS accountType, '선교헌금계좌' AS accountLabel, '국민은행' AS bankName, '987-654-321098' AS accountNumber, '다사랑교회' AS accountHolder
SELECT '주정헌금' AS purpose, '주' AS abbreviation UNION ALL SELECT '십일조헌금', '십' UNION ALL SELECT '감사헌금', '감' UNION ALL SELECT '선교헌금', '선'
